{{Short description|Statistical software package}}
'''ASReml''' is a statistical software package for fitting linear [[mixed model]]s using [[restricted maximum likelihood]], a technique commonly used in [[plant breeding|plant]] and [[animal breeding]] and [[quantitative genetics]] as well as other fields. It is notable for its ability to fit very large and complex [[data set]]s efficiently, due to its use of the average information algorithm<ref>Gilmour, A.R., Thompson, R. and Cullis, B.R. (1995). Average Information REML, an efficient algorithm for variance parameter estimation in linear mixed models. ''Biometrics'' 51, 1440-50</ref> and [[sparse matrix]] methods.

It was originally developed by Arthur Gilmour.<ref>[http://www.cargovale.com.au/ASReml/faq.htm Arthur Gilmour, Cargovale]</ref>

ASREML can be used in Windows, Linux, and as an add-on to [[S-PLUS]] and [[R (programming language)|R]].
